Our doors are open to the community offering football pitch hire for all on 5, 7, and 8-a-side arenas, kid's parties, corporate events, functions, and hall hire. Football is a great way to have fun and get fit and with our artificial surface, ProTurf®, you'll be playing as close to grass as you can be. It's designed specifically for small-sided football, and completely exclusive to GOALS delivering natural gameplay, pace, and is easier on your joints allowing you to play for longer. Choose a casual pitch booking for game time with no commitment, playing when you like, as often as you like. Dedicated baller? We've got you covered with a block booking. Secure the same pitch at the same time every week with 0 upfront cost, simply pay as normal every week. You'll also be eligible for loyalty vouchers that can be used to pay for those post-match pints in our players' lounge. Play football, get fit, feel good. A dedicated in-house events team are on hand to help with catering, decorations, and music options, leaving you free to relax and enjoy your occasion. Our modern function suite is available on selected weekdays, Saturdays, and Sundays. Our hall holds up to 120 people, including children so you won't need to compromise on your guestlist. A late license is available on request, for a small additional charge so you can party into midnight. Hassle-free functions for as little as a refundable £150 deposit. Hall hire, event hire, weddings, engagement parties, retirement parties, or milestone birthdays, whatever your event, we can look after you. Get in touch below and let us take care of the rest. ENQUIRE FOOTBALL KIDS PARTIES Enjoy an unforgettable kids party at GOALS whatever the weather, on our outdoor all-weather ProTurf pitches. Whether you choose our Premier Party or prefer to Build Your Own, your little football star is guaranteed a day to remember. Parties are priced based on a minimum of 10 children, with the option to add more guests for an additional cost – either when booking or closer to the big day. Every party takes place in a fun, safe and fully supervised environment, giving you peace of mind while the kids enjoy non-stop football action. And that's just the start – from Panini goodies and party bags to trophies, medals, and tasty upgrades like pizza, ice cream and slushies, there are loads of ways to make their big day even more unforgettable. FIND OUT MORE KICKABOUT Maybe you're not a planner, after a casual Kickabout with a few friends or, you're a parent trying to keep your children active; our Kickabout sessions are a flexible way to level up. Pitches are available from the early morning right through to late night sessions on fully enclosed arenas from only £5 per player on 5-a-side or £7 per player on 7-a-side.
